seriesTitle: The Last Days of Ptolemy Grey

episodes.title: Reggie
episodes.summary: Ptolemy Grey's memory is getting worse. After learning his grand-nephew is no longer there for him, Ptolemy's niece assigns him a new caretaker.

episodes.title: Robyn
episodes.summary: Kicked out by Niecie, Robyn moves in with Ptolemy and accompanies him to a doctor's appointment for an experimental treatment.

episodes.title: Sensia
episodes.summary: Ptolemy begins treatment to restore his memories, drifting in and out of fever dreams about his life as Robyn keeps vigil at his side.

episodes.title: Coydog
episodes.summary: After unearthing a long-forgotten treasure, Ptolemy makes a plan. Later, he meets with a friend of Reggie's and learns revelatory details.

episodes.title: Nina
episodes.summary: Ptolemy looks to his longtime friend and lawyer to help protect Robyn. A family gathering in Reggie's honor brings both healing and confrontation.

episodes.title: Ptolemy
episodes.summary: Series finale. Ptolemy must settle all scores and make peace with his past—before he loses his memories once and for all.
